'''Essande''' is Elayne's maid at the Royal Palace in [[Caemlyn]], chosen after Elayne's return. She is [[Andoran]], sworn to [[House Trakand]].

== Appearance ==
Essande is slim, dignified, white-haired and slow moving. She wore Elayne's Golden Lily embroidered large on her breast, and her gray skirts were trimmed in red. {{Ref|{{twotc}}, Essande}}

== Family ==
Her niece [[Melfane Dawlish|Melfane]] became Elayne's midwife. 

==Activities==
She chose [[Naris Pelden]] and her sister [[Sephanie Pelden|Sephanie]] to be trained as Elayne's maids because they were unlikely to be spies.{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Naris Pelden}}

She knew the job and did not waste time on chatter. Sometimes she suggested clothes and made the same comment every day, that Elayne reminded her of [[Morgase]]. She reserved certain tasks for herself, such as dressing and undressing Elayne. She denied that her joints ached and refused [[Healing]].
